text: Mechanical engineering is an engineering discipline that, based on mechanics, materials science and control theory, studies the design, manufacture, operation and optimization of mechanical systems. This major is dedicated to transforming theory into practical application, covering the entire process from component design to complete machine system integration. It is a core supporting discipline in fields such as industrial manufacturing, aerospace, and new energy. Its essence is to solve practical problems through "machinery", which combines technicality and engineering practicality.
